question: Where is the nearest attraction encountered en route to Anya & Andrew Shiva Gallery, New York, NY from Science Hall East, Wayne, NJ?
sql: WITH origin AS ( SELECT geometry FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%Science Hall East%' AND addr_city ILIKE '%Wayne%' AND addr_state ILIKE '%NJ%' LIMIT 1 ), destination AS ( SELECT geometry FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%Anya & Andrew Shiva Gallery%' AND addr_city ILIKE '%New York%' AND addr_state ILIKE '%NY%' LIMIT 1 ), route_path AS ( SELECT ST_MakeLine(o.geometry, d.geometry) AS line_geom FROM origin AS o, destination AS d ), buffered_route AS ( SELECT ST_Buffer(rp.line_geom::geography, 500) AS buffered_geom -- 500 meters buffer around the straight-line path FROM route_path AS rp ) SELECT p.poi_name, p.addr_city, p.addr_state FROM pois AS p, buffered_route AS br, origin AS o WHERE p.tourism = 'attraction' AND ST_Intersects(p.geometry::geography, br.buffered_geom) ORDER BY ST_Distance(p.geometry::geography, o.geometry::geography) -- Order by distance to the origin point LIMIT 1;
